name: SuperTokens
tagline: Open source auth with pre-built UI. Email/password, social, MFA, passwordless.
shortDescription: SuperTokens is an open source authentication solution with pre-built login/signup UIs. Email/password, social login, MFA, passwordless (email/SMS), session management, role-based access.
longDescription:
## What it is

SuperTokens is an open source authentication solution. Pre-built login/signup UI components (React, React Native, Vue, Angular), session management, email/password, social login, passwordless (email/SMS), MFA, and role-based access control.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a complete auth solution with pre-built UI but don't want to lock into Auth0, SuperTokens is the answer. The UI components are well-designed and customizable, and the backend is Apache-2.0.

## When to use it

- Apps that need login/signup UI without building it
- Auth0 alternative with self-hosting
- Email/password + social + MFA in one
- When you want pre-built session management
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name supertokens -p 3567:3567 registry.supertokens.io/supertokens/supertokens-core
```

**Managed (SuperTokens Cloud):** 5K MAU free. From $0.02/MAU after.
